summary: The change adds a permanent exemption in payments purge_due so closed tax-authority payees are never disposed of, which breaks the requirement to purge closed-payee NPI after the approved retention period unless a legal hold applies. No valid exception authorizes that deviation. Change-ticket, independent approval, commit coverage, CI on the head commit, and the conditional security, control-owner, emergency, and evidence-lapse checks are in order, but the retention breach requires rejection.
